brief:
An Israeli drone strike on Deir al-Balah in central Gaza injured three Palestinians, one of whom sustained critical injuries, the Wafa news agency reported. Emergency responders transported all three casualties to al-Aqsa hospital for medical treatment following the attack.

The incident occurred as Israeli military operations continue across the Gaza Strip. Deir al-Balah, a densely populated city in central Gaza, has been repeatedly targeted during the ongoing conflict. The strike added to a mounting toll of injuries among civilians in the territory, where medical facilities face severe strain from the volume of casualties.
dek: Israeli drone strike injures three in central Gaza An Israeli drone strike on Deir al-Balah in central Gaza has injured three Palestinians, one of whom is in critical condition, according to the Wafa news agency. All three were taken to al-Aqsa hospital.
title: Israeli drone strike injures three Palestinians in central Gaza
